summary: Froze PEC-001 v1.0 (Publication Execution Contract), converting Phase 144A's Publication Execution Ownership Architecture into a numbered, falsifiable contract -- mirroring exactly how Phase 143B converted Phase 143A into CHGR-001. Read in full before drafting: docs/PHASE_144A_PUBLICATION_EXECUTION_OWNERSHIP_ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/contracts/INTERACTIVE_WORKFLOW_CONTRACT.md (IWC-001 v1.1, Sec1, Sec2, Sec10, Sec11.1, Sec11.4, Sec13.1-13.2, Sec18/18.4, Sec19/19.1, Sec21.18), docs/contracts/CANONICAL_HUMAN_GOVERNANCE_RECORD_CONTRACT.md (CHGR-001 v1.0, Sec7, Sec8, Sec9, Sec10, Sec11, Sec13, Sec17, Sec19.1, Sec20/20.5), docs/contracts/TYPED_AUTHORITY_MODEL_CONSUMPTION_CONTRACT.md (TAMC-001), docs/contracts/TYPED_AUTHORITY_MODEL_PRODUCTION_CONSUMPTION_CONTRACT.md (TAMPC-001), the Canonical Phase Finalization Architecture (Phase 134), Canonical Lifecycle State Authority Architecture (Phase 135), Governance Lifecycle Pattern Architecture/Contract (Phase 137V, GLP-001 Sec6.1), phase reports 143J-143P, docs/PHASE_143B_CANONICAL_HUMAN_GOVERNANCE_RECORD_CONTRACT_FREEZE.md (precedent for this freeze's own structure), and PROJECT_STATUS.md. PEC-001 freezes the Publication Coordinator's sole responsibility and enumerated non-responsibilities (external to interactive_workflow/**, the PCAE phase-lifecycle tree, and cltr/**); the central invariant that Publication Readiness is never Publication Authorization; the Authorization Event Contract, ratifying 144A Sec5's Model 2 (explicit human-operated CLI invocation) as the v1.0 authority boundary, excluding autonomous triggering outright, and naming Model 3 (a delegated authorization token) as a permitted future hardening layer rather than adopting it now; deterministic Publication Execution semantics (atomicity, binary rollback, no discretionary step); the Publication Readiness Package's continued immutability, authority-neutrality, and publication-neutrality; the CHGR boundary (Coordinator may create a CHGR atomically; may not authorize publication, determine readiness, modify Interactive Workflow, alter Confirmation, or mutate evidence); a definitive responsibility matrix; fail-closed failure semantics; a security contract; and a compatibility analysis independently re-confirming IWC-001, CHGR-001, TAMC-001, and TAMPC-001 are satisfied without any section renumbered, reworded, or contradicted. 110 requirements (PEC-REQ-001 through PEC-REQ-110), sequential, no gaps, no reuse, independently confirmed via grep extraction. Nine adversarial scenarios run against the draft requirement set; every scenario resolved to an existing, citable mitigation. One judgment call disclosed in-place (PEC-001 Sec6, Sec14): ratifying Model 2 rather than Model 3 for v1.0. Zero files under src/ or tests/ were created, modified, or deleted. See docs/PHASE_144B_PUBLICATION_EXECUTION_CONTRACT_FREEZE.md.
